purpose: Occasional-actions register slice (Marathon R11 lane BA; Higgins 2008, DCC Curation Lifecycle Model, IJDC 3(1) — pattern only). One appended line per occasional (non-pipeline) curation event: {kind: 'occasional-action', date: YYYY-MM-DD, page, action: one of reappraisal/migration/format-refresh/integrity-review/disposal-review/access-review, trigger, outcome: one of completed/no-change/deferred/rejected/superseded, actor, note}. Append-only; the register logs events, it performs none. Maintained with scripts/wiki_occasional_actions.py. This header line is the only line until an operator records an event — seeded empty-but-valid.
